name: cognitience-pp
description: Cognitience PP — local-first presentation app with liquid glass UI and Rust backend
author: Cognitience

scripts.dist: cargo build --release && node scripts/make-icon.js && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --win portable
scripts.dist:dir: cargo build --release && node scripts/make-icon.js && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --win dir
scripts.dist:mac: cargo build --release && node scripts/make-icon.js && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --mac zip --arm64
scripts.dist:mac:x64: rustup target add x86_64-apple-darwin && cargo build --release --target x86_64-apple-darwin && node scripts/make-icon.js && COG_RUST_TARGET=x86_64-apple-darwin CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --mac zip --x64
